title: ExamOven Demo Exam 2026 - ExamOven Features - Custom Exams - Schema
subject: ExamOven Features

questions.q: When creating a custom JSON exam, which of the following fields is **MANDATORY** for every question object?
questions.explain: Every question MUST have a `question_text`, `options`, and a `correct_answer`. Fields like `difficulty`, `topic`, and `explanation` are optional but highly recommended for a better experience.
